edits.old: Helium (announced Dec 2025, production 2027) is a 2D switched FPA
edits.new: Helium (announced Dec 2025; production in 2027 [U], a date that Voyant's release does not give) is a 2D switched FPA
edits.why: Voyant's 17 Dec 2025 release and five trade reports of it (Robotics 24/7, LiDAR News, Engineering.com, PIC Magazine, Embedded, Metrology News) give a CES 2026 prototype and early access but no production date; two further articles (Unmanned Systems Technology, Forbes) refused access. Searched 5 Oct 2026.
